notes: Identity inspected: canonical text contains the full two-page primary Short Report, The Value Heuristic in Judgments of Relative Frequency, by Xianchi Dai, Klaus Wertenbroch, and C. Miguel Brendl, Psychological Science, Volume 19—Number 1, pp. 18–19, copyright 2008. Title, authors, journal, year and pages match the neutral reference. DOI is not printed; provenance header identifies the Wharton faculty published-paper file. Method, Results, Discussion and References are present. No PDF supplied. The main comparison tests categorical judgment errors for the endowed (value) versus nonendowed category across the two endowment conditions. It is not a continuous paired-error test. Canonical OCR w2 denotes chi-square and 5 denotes equals. The same test prints odds ratio 3.28; requested test statistic retained. Randomness-rating correlation r = –.047, p = .712 tests a different relationship and is excluded. Original n, replication and success are unassigned placeholders.
